in_marathi.name: Sambhavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who is born or will be born
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sambhavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit root 'sam' meaning 'to exist or become' and 'bhav' meaning 'to be', symbolizing the belief in the cyclical nature of life and the hope for future prosperity and growth.
